issue.title: Migrate chezmoi agy snippets and tmux_ai_window off stale Flash selectors
issue.description: Proposing bead: sase-1ss.1, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #4 (chezmoi half). Work in the linked chezmoi repository via /sase_repo and its printed checkout; do not edit live home files. Independent source review finds home/dot_config/sase/sase.yml m_agy and m_agy_pro at lines 352-353 pin gemini-3.7-flash-high; m_agy_pro_flash at 354 pools 3.7 and 3.6 Flash; m_swarm at 366 pins 3.7 Flash. home/bin/executable_tmux_ai_window:302 hard-codes the same invalid fallback. agy 1.5.8 models currently exposes neither family; accepted research documents the 3.7 launch rejection. Replace these with supported fixed-effort selectors, preserving snippet intent and avoiding a provider ladder policy change. Gemini 3.8 Flash is the conservative replacement; deliberate Hydrogen choices must retain slug-based effort. Update tests/bash/tmux_ai_window_test.sh and any relevant config assertions, run the chezmoi checks, and follow its AGENTS.md deployment rules. Coordinate with the SASE reads/examples task; broader catalog membership remains sase-1l4. Small because it is a bounded literal-config migration, independent of the completed epic.

task_type_fields.impact: m_agy*, m_swarm, and the tmux agy fallback choose inaccessible model IDs instead of using the repaired SASE defaults.
task_type_fields.repro: In the /sase_repo-opened chezmoi checkout, rg -n "gemini-3\.[67]-flash" home/dot_config/sase/sase.yml home/bin/executable_tmux_ai_window; compare the resulting explicit pins with agy models on 1.5.8, which omits both families.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1ss.1 note #4; the home snippets and tmux fallback hard-code 3.7/3.6 Flash, bypassing the new accessible SASE tier defaults.
